Are you passionate about connecting digital strategy with hands-on execution to drive measurable marketing impact across European markets?

As our new Digital Marketing Manager, Western Europe, you'll shape and deliver the regional digital marketing agenda across 16 Western European markets, combining strategic direction with hands-on activation that strengthens customer engagement, lead generation, and conversion.

What you will be doing

As a key member of the Western Europe Marketing team, you'll create impact by translating business priorities into connected, measurable digital experiences that drive customer engagement and marketing effectiveness across one of Grundfos' most important regions.

Your main responsibilities include:

• Set and drive the digital marketing direction for Western Europe across 16 markets, translating regional business priorities into a clear digital roadmap aligned with global platforms, frameworks and best practices.

• Plan, execute and optimise multi-channel digital campaigns across websites, email, social media and search, aligned with regional priorities and customer journeys.

• Drive web performance and local optimisation across Western Europe, including SEO/GEO, traffic development and digital customer journeys, identifying opportunities to improve discovery, engagement and conversion.

• Track, analyse and report on digital performance, campaign ROI and KPIs, using A/B testing and performance insights to identify trends and deliver actionable optimisation recommendations.

• Support marketing technology adoption, automation, lead scoring, nurturing workflows and CRM integration to improve lead quality, conversion and alignment with Sales.

• Identify and translate emerging digital trends, including AI-driven discovery and changing search behaviour, into opportunities, while building digital capabilities and supporting execution across local teams.

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you're a strategic yet hands-on digital marketing professional who thrives at the intersection of planning and execution, with strong stakeholder management skills and a passion for turning data into better customer experiences. We'd also imagine that you have:

• 5+ years of experience in digital marketing roles covering strategy, campaign activation, and performance optimisation across multiple markets or regions.

• Hands-on expertise across the digital ecosystem, including web/CMS, SEO, paid media, marketing automation (e.g. Marketo), analytics, and lead management.

• Experience working in international matrix organisations, enabling collaboration across global, regional, and local teams.

• A strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate performance data into clear actions and priorities.

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.

• On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

About Grundfos

Grundfos is one of the world’s leading water technology companies with more than 19.000 employees in 60+ countries all over the world. Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

Take technical ownership of our launched medical devices – driving product improvements, resolving technical challenges and ensuring long-term product performance.

Can you combine strong engineering judgement with hands-on technical work, take ownership of product design challenges and drive solutions through to completion?

Qufora develops intuitive medical devices that help people with chronic bowel disorders live a more fulfilled life. We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Owner to take technical responsibility for our launched products and help ensure their continued safety, performance and compliance.

Based at our headquarters in Allerød, north of Copenhagen, you will join our R&D organisation and work closely with colleagues across R&D, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Commercial, as well as external manufacturing partners.

Your role

As Technical Product Owner (TPO), you will have overall technical responsibility for the design of assigned launched products, including packaging and labelling. You will maintain a clear overview of their design status, performance, quality and technical documentation throughout their lifecycle.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you combine technical ownership with practical problem-solving. You will carry out technical work yourself where appropriate and involve specialists when their expertise is needed.

For smaller, straightforward changes, you will manage the activities yourself. For larger or more complex initiatives, a Project Manager will support planning and cross-functional coordination, while you retain responsibility for the technical scope and execution.

Your key responsibilities

• Maintain technical product ownership: Take over product knowledge and documentation from development and keep product requirements, specifications, risk assessments and design documentation up to date.

• Monitor product performance: Evaluate feedback from complaints, post-market surveillance and production data to identify technical issues, risks and opportunities for improvement.

• Investigate and resolve technical issues: Lead technical investigations and apply Structured Problem Solving, including root cause analysis, to address product failures and design-related quality issues.

• Drive product design changes: Assess technical impacts, initiate and manage Change Requests (CRs) and Change Orders (COs), and ensure that required design changes and documentation updates are completed.

• Plan and execute verification: Define acceptance criteria, plan verification activities, perform selected tests and analyse and document results, involving relevant specialists as needed.

• Ensure continued design compliance: Assess the technical impact of new standards, regulatory requirements and product changes, and ensure that necessary technical actions and documentation are completed.

• Drive product improvements: Identify and implement design improvements that strengthen product performance, quality, manufacturability, supply reliability or cost efficiency.

Your experience and qualifications

• A relevant degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, with minimum 5 years of experience in medical device development or medical device lifecycle management.

• Practical experience with design control, change control, risk management and technical documentation within an ISO 13485 quality management system.

• Working knowledge of ISO 14971, EU MDR and relevant medical device regulatory requirements.

• Experience with technical impact assessments, product requirements, risk assessments and verification of product design changes.

• Strong capabilities in Structured Problem Solving, technical investigations and interpretation of test and product performance data.

• A practical understanding of how product design, materials and manufacturing processes interact and affect product safety, performance and quality.

• Familiarity with PLM/PDM systems, controlled product documentation and engineering change processes.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Experience with polymer components, injection moulding and external manufacturing partners is an advantage.

How you work

You are a structured, analytical and pragmatic engineer who combines sound technical judgement with a hands-on approach. You take ownership of challenges, work independently when appropriate and follow issues through to resolution.

You recognise when specialist expertise is needed and know how to bring the right people together to reach sound technical decisions.

You work closely with the Commercial Product Manager to align technical activities with customer and business needs, and collaborate with Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and external manufacturing partners to understand dependencies and ensure that product design changes can be implemented effectively.

You communicate clearly, challenge assumptions constructively and balance product performance, patient safety, quality, supply and cost when evaluating technical solutions.

What we offer

A role with genuine technical responsibility for medical devices that make a difference in people's everyday lives.

You will join a relatively small and flat organisation with short decision paths and the opportunity to influence both product improvements and how we manage our products throughout their lifecycle.

At Qufora, you will work with a broad range of technical challenges, from design control and verification to product investigations and improvements. Your technical judgement and initiative will have a visible impact.

You will be part of an R&D organisation where we value technical expertise, practical problem-solving and collaboration – and where we believe that having fun along the way is just as important.

Interested?

If you enjoy taking technical ownership, solving engineering challenges and improving products already used by patients every day, we would like to hear from you. Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV and a brief description of your motivation for the role. We will review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

Shape how AI transforms one of Denmark’s leading B2B businesses

AI is changing how we serve our customers, operate our business and create value. In TDC Erhverv, our goal is not simply to launch more AI use cases. We want to use AI to transform customer journeys, commercial activities, delivery and operations end to end.

We are therefore looking for a Head of AI, TDC Erhverv to set the direction and turn that goal into measurable business impact.

This is not primarily a technology role. It is a senior business transformation role with AI at its core.

You will shape and advance our B2B AI agenda. You will connect technology opportunities with strategic business priorities and bring together people and capabilities across the organization to turn AI potential into tangible customer and business value.

Your role

As Head of AI, you will be the senior orchestration point for the AI agenda across TDC Erhverv.

You will own and develop our AI strategy and roadmap and build a coherent portfolio of AI initiatives around customer journeys, business domains and end-to-end value chains.

You will identify where AI, process redesign, automation, data and technology can come together to create broader business transformation and where capabilities can be reused and scaled across the organization.

You will work closely with senior leaders across TDC Erhverv as well as Technology, data, architecture, security and other capabilities across TDC Brands. The role operates through a federated model, which means effective performance depends on your ability to create direction, mobilize highly skilled colleagues and lead through influence rather than formal authority.

Your responsibilities

You will:

• Set the strategic direction and ambition for AI across TDC Erhverv.

• Own and develop our B2B AI strategy, roadmap and portfolio.

• Identify and prioritize the AI opportunities with the greatest potential to create customer and business value.

• Connect individual AI opportunities into broader customer journey and end-to-end transformation agendas.

• Drive AI initiatives from opportunity and qualification through prioritization, delivery, adoption and scaling.

• Ensure clear business ownership, measurable outcomes and benefit realization.

• Reassess, reorder, or discontinue initiatives when business value, feasibility, or ownership is lacking.

• Build effective collaboration between business, Technology, data and other specialist capabilities.

• Strengthen AI adoption and capabilities across TDC Erhverv.

• Advise senior leadership on AI opportunities, priorities, investments, dependencies and risks.

• Represent TDC Erhverv in relevant internal and external AI forums and strategic partnerships.

Who are you?

We are looking for someone who combines AI understanding, solid business judgement and transformation leadership.

We don't expect you to build the models or write the code. But you need sufficient technological depth to understand what is possible, challenge the right questions and engage credibly with senior Technology, data and architecture stakeholders.

We expect that you:

• Have a solid grasp of generative AI, agentic AI, and the opportunities AI can create for large organizations.

• Have experience translating new technology into business strategy, transformation and measurable value.

• Can connect strategic goals with execution and prioritization.

• Demonstrate sound business judgment and evaluate opportunities using customer value, financial impact, feasibility, scalability, and risk.

• Are comfortable navigating complex organizations and leading cross-functional agendas without necessarily having formal authority.

• Can engage senior stakeholders in a constructive way and help shape decisions.

• Communicate clearly and effectively, making complex topics easy for diverse audiences to understand and connect with.

• Bring curiosity and an external perspective on how AI is changing businesses, industries and customer expectations.

• Understand the importance of responsible AI, governance, security and data protection.

What success looks like

We will not measure success by how many AI pilots we launch.

Success means that AI creates documented improvements in our business, including better customer experience, increased productivity and efficiency, better commercial performance and scalable ways of working. It also means building an organization where AI becomes embedded in relevant workflows, rather than remaining a collection of stand-alone experiments.

Why this role?

This is a unique opportunity to shape how an entire B2B business uses one of the most consequential technologies of our time.

You will operate at the intersection of strategy, business transformation and technology, with direct exposure to senior leadership and a mandate stretching from setting strategic direction to creating measurable business outcomes.

jobs.occupation: PhD Scholarship in Nonlinear Nanophotonics: Trapping Light for Extreme Light–Matter Interactions - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Are you an experimental physicist eager to push light–matter interaction to its extremes? 

We offer a PhD scholarship at DTU Electro, where you will trap light in nanoscale optical cavities coupled to highly nonlinear 2D materials, and control them to let light interact with light far more strongly than conventional devices allow.

To trap and release light on demand, we use photonic crystal cavities in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), whose strong electro-optic effect allows fast electrical control. Our team has recently demonstrated ultracompact TFLN cavities used as modulators [1], with electrically controllable coupling to waveguides [2], and as multiport switches [3]. The project builds on these results and shares fabrication efforts with our collaborators at Harvard University, who pioneered the TFLN platform [4].

Photons interact only through a material nonlinearity, and in conventional static cavities the interaction time is fundamentally bounded, which dynamically coupled cavities can overcome [5]. You will combine such cavities with atomically thin 2D semiconductors with exceptionally strong nonlinearities to explore a largely uncharted dynamic regime of nonlinear optics, aiming to generate quantum states of light, such as squeezed light, at ultralow energies. The project is part of the Center for Nanophotonics (NanoPhoton), a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation.

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will drive the experimental work in the project from device design to demonstration, working closely with PhD students, postdocs, and senior researchers at DTU and our collaborators at Harvard University. Depending on your interests, you will have the opportunity to:

• Design photonic crystal cavities and circuits using electromagnetic and multiphysics simulations.
• Fabricate devices in DTU Nanolab’s state-of-the-art cleanroom.
• Integrate 2D materials with photonic chips.
• Characterize devices using high-speed electro-optic, pulsed-laser, and quantum-optical measurements.
• Compare your experiments with theoretical models of cavity dynamics.
• Present your results at international conferences and in leading journals.
You are curious and driven, enjoy hands-on laboratory work, and take ownership of the progress and quality of your work.

Required qualifications:

• A strong background in optics or photonics.
• Experimental experience in optics or photonics, e.g., from your master’s project.
• Programming experience in Python.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Desired qualifications:

• Nanofabrication or integrated photonics.
• Nonlinear or quantum optics, or 2D materials.
Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
Assessment of the candidates will be carried out by Associate Professor Mikkel Heuck and Professor Jesper Mørk.

We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

You will join a research team at DTU Electro that is part of NanoPhoton, an interdisciplinary center that brings together several DTU departments. NanoPhoton is a highly collaborative and international community of PhD students, postdocs, senior researchers and professors, where theorists and experimentalists work side by side. We value curiosity, openness and helping each other. Questions are always welcome, and experienced colleagues will help you get started in the laboratory and cleanroom.

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

References
[1] H. Larocque et al., ACS Photonics 11, 3860 (2024).
[2] M. Rasmussen et al., Optica Quantum 2.0, QM4B.4 (2025).
[3] A. Buzzi et al., arXiv:2610.31757 (2026).
[4] D. Zhu et al., Adv. Opt. Photon. 13, 242 (2021).
[5] M. Heuck et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 124, 160501 (2020).

At the Section for Quantum Physics and Information Technology (QPIT), we are seeking an excellent and highly motivated PhD candidate to work on the study of quantum states of macroscopic systems of light and matter. In particular, on the development of novel protocols for generating and controlling macroscopic states in optomechanical systems, quantifying their macroscopicity, and exploiting them for precision sensing and for exploring the limits of quantum theory and potentially probing quantum gravity. The work will be theoretical, in close collaboration with our local experimental team and international collaborators.
